name: Kosmicheskie prikljuchenija vahtjora Vahtanga
source:
Today the two greatest gatemen Vakhtang and his friend Piggo went to work, as they always do. But they don't know yet that this day is special. Today, the fate of the entire galaxy is decided. The fate of billions of intelligent beings depends only on your choice.

[From [url=https://kosmocat.itch.io/vakhtang-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天，两位最伟大的看门人瓦赫唐和他的朋友皮戈像往常一样去上班。但他们还不知道这一天很特别。今天，整个银河系的命运已经决定。数十亿智慧生命的命运仅取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://kosmocat.itch.io/vakhtang-1]Itch.io[/url]]
